_comment: MW2's underbarrel shotgun. Every number is MW2's own weapon data from the IW4 dump's weapons/mp files: m4_shotgun_attach_mp (the alt weapon) and m4_shotgun_mp (the host's alt fields). The only values not in MW2's weapon files are marked placeholder below; they come from the model's notetracks once it exists. Run python3 dev/tools/build_masterkey.py after editing; --check is read-only.
_reload_end_close_ms: placeholder: MW2 keeps the reload end's pump in the xanim's notetracks, not the weapon file. Set it from the model's chamber notetrack (weap_shotattach_chamber_plr).
_idle_ms: placeholder: the idle loop's length is picture only.
